meaning:
εὐτραπελία, -ας, ἡ
(εὖ, τρέπω),
1. versatility, wit, facetiousness (Hippocr., Plat., al.).
2. = βωμολογία, coarse jesting, ribaldry (Abbott, Essays, 93): Eph.5:4.†
SYN.: μωρολογία, see Tr., Syn., § xxxiv (AS)

elsewhere.note: nor filthiness, nor foolish talking, nor jesting, which are not appropriate, but rather giving of thanks.
